entities.summary: Phyllis Akua Opoku-Gyimah, also known as Lady Phyll, is a British political activist known for her work for racial, gender and LGBT+ equality. She is co-founder and chief executive of UK Black Pride, executive director of DIVA Magazine and former executive director of Kaleidoscope Trust.
